definitions.explanation: operated by turning a handle by hand rather than by electricity or motor

definitions.gloss: preparation; arrangements; making arrangements in advance
definitions.explanation: preparing or arranging things beforehand, often behind the scenes

notes:
{手回|てまわ}し has two distinct senses: hand-operated (physical) and making arrangements (abstract).

SENSE 1 — HAND-OPERATED:
Used as a modifier before nouns to describe hand-cranked or manually operated devices:
- {手回|てまわ}しオルガン: hand-cranked organ
- {手回|てまわ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発電機|はつでんき}→発電機：29732_hatsudenki⟧: hand-cranked generator
- {手回|てまわ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミシン→ミシン：06365_mishin⟧: hand-operated sewing machine

SENSE 2 — ARRANGEMENTS:
Often used in set expressions about preparing or arranging things efficiently:
- {手回|てまわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: good at making arrangements
- {手回|てまわ}し⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: with good preparation, efficiently
- {手回|てまわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧: arrangements are complete
